title: Function Health press wall
description: A serif heading and lead line over a four-column masonry of tiles: cream award tiles (a serif publication name, mono caption) alternate with dark photo cards carrying a white quote and a mono name, each column pairing one short and one tall tile. On phones the columns become a sideways snap rail.
notes: quote tiles assume a photo behind them (a dark fade sits under the text); the placeholder is dark
award tiles use plain text names; swap in a logo with the same props if you have one
